title: Juicy Light Spanish Vegetables Pisto Manchego
description: A floral and light Spanish dish featuring tamarind paste, score-fat, and keto-friendly ingredients, perfect for a crowd-pleaser, this Pisto Manchego recipe is a must-try for any vegetable lover.
instructions: Heat the melted score-fat in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced zucchini and bell peppers, and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the tamarind paste mixture, smoked paprika, and salt.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes, until the vegetables are very tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
